blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Riverwood. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Riverwood, Port Coquitlam: 10 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 8 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Riverwood rose from 7 in June to 10 in September, and 3 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.5% of Port Coquitlam’s 153 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Riverwood?
Riverwood also had 21 condos and townhomes listed and 8 sold in September, against 10 houses listed. The Riverwood condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Riverwood?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Riverwood. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Riverwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Riverwood had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Riverwood from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Riverwood over those 4 months, out of 72 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Riverwood?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
